annotations.title: Before building: requirements and reference code

description: Accessibility requirements for an interactive component or screen that is about to be designed or built: menus, dialogs, carousels, tabs, forms, drag and drop, custom controls, cards, tables, charts, animation, and the wireframes, mockups and prototypes for them. Takes the request in the user’s own words and returns the guides that apply with the requirements to build in from the start (keys, roles and names, focus, what is announced), working reference code, and the checks split into what an agent can confirm and what a person must. When the request itself breaks a rule (autoplay with no pause, a placeholder as the only label, a div as a button, hover-only menus, removed focus outlines, disabled zoom), it also returns a version that keeps what the user wanted and passes, and one sentence that explains the change.

limit.description: Guides to return at most (default 6, max 12)

locale.description: Language of the answer and the guides: en (default) or ja. English answers cite EN 301 549 and Section 508; Japanese answers cite JIS X 8341-3:2016.

request.description: What the user asked for, in their words, e.g. "autoplaying hero carousel", "custom dropdown with search", "カード全体をクリックできる一覧"

name: before_building
